html:
In 1888 Brunei became a British protectorate, and from 1906 a British Resident advised the sultan on all matters except religion and custom.

By then Brunei had lost most of its land. The Brooke rajahs of Sarawak had taken river after river, and the British North Borneo Company held Sabah. In 1890 the Brookes seized Limbang, splitting Brunei into two pieces.

British protection froze those borders. The discovery of oil at Seria in 1929 then made the small state rich. Brunei stayed a protectorate until independence in 1984 under Hassanal Bolkiah.
sum: In 1888 Brunei became a British protectorate, and from 1906 a British Resident advised the sultan on all matters except religion and custom.
